name: Webfiles PHP Dev Container
postCreateCommand: apt-get update && apt-get install -y git libpng-dev libzip-dev unzip && docker-php-ext-install gd exif mysqli zip && php -r "copy('https://getcomposer.org/installer', 'composer-setup.php');" && php composer-setup.php --install-dir=/usr/local/bin --filename=composer && rm composer-setup.php && composer install --optimize-autoloader && a2enmod rewrite
